canonical_claim: The TBM Competitiveness formula captures the ratio between the length and diameter of the tunnel and the unconfined compressive strength, serving to identify the conditions under which the use of a Tunnel Boring Machine (TBM) may be appropriate.
The value of 1.5 represents the trade-off limit between the two methods.
Açılan deliklere önceden hesaplanmış miktarda patlayıcılar yerleştirilir.
